analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - October 27, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: Macro calls of the day: Hatzius flags downside growth risks in Global Views, and Peters (Global Economics Comment) sees a moderate boost to developed-market inflation from AI demand.
Energy: Mehta says oil E&Ps are well positioned even at a long-term WTI price of $70-$75/bbl. Highlighted Buys are PR, DVN and OXY, and OXY is on the Conviction List.

Healthcare: Richter published takeaways from a lung cancer KOL event at ESMO. Separate notes cover ESMO data for JNJ (prostate cancer, OrigAMI-4), PFE (25-valent PCV infant Phase 2), MRK (sac-TMT) and AstraZeneca (sone-ve 3L data compelling, 2L more nuanced, AVANZAR delayed).
Europe building materials: Martin sees near- and medium-term supply and demand challenges in US residential roofing.
Asia: Sumitomo Bakelite (4203.T) initiated at Buy as a leader in AI thermal management and LEO satellite advanced packaging, with M&A expanding the growth story.
China Healthcare: Chen says positive Phase 3 data validate CLDN18.2 ADCs. Sone-Ve differentiates on patient breadth and IBI343 leads on efficacy depth.

Rating changes: Weg SA (WEGE3.SA) upgraded to Buy from Neutral. Gjensidige (GJFG.OL) downgraded to Neutral from Buy as pricing normalises. Richful (300910.SZ) downgraded to Neutral from Buy after a 3Q26 miss on export headwinds.

Target price changes of 10% or more: OXY to $76 from $69, WEGE3 to R$55.60 from R$44.10, OVV to $72 from $65, MUR to $44 from $36. In Asia, Richful cut to Rmb27 from Rmb50, Yankershop Food cut to Rmb48 from Rmb56, OPT Machine Vision raised to Rmb115.90 from Rmb105, and Nexchip cut to Rmb44 from Rmb51.40.
Energy M&A: Ovintiv plans to acquire Logan Energy for US$890M (C$1.26B). EQT announced a strategic acquisition of RRC for more than $50B in combined enterprise value.
Strategy: GOAL Kickstart says the Risk Appetite Indicator is negative as Tech dominates cross-asset moves. The Global Weekly Kickstart is titled 'Momentum Unwinds as the Cost of Capital Rises'.

Consumer/retail: the Target note says consumer perception remains below historical levels with negative social media sentiment. Dollar General's 3Q26 preview says metrics remain strong but are moderating from peak 2Q levels.

Tech: Cadence (CDNS) strong guidance suggests momentum in AI tool adoption and recurring revenue. Amkor (AMKR) has weaker smartphone and consumer results offsetting strength in computing and advanced packaging.
Meta announced an equity offering. GS notes recent earnings showed early Muse success and core business momentum.
Instacart: GS framed its thesis after press reports of M&A. Truist: GS assessed a potential AFCO Credit sale following a Bloomberg report.

Earnings reactions: Verizon 3Q26 was a beat and raise but service revenue missed. JetBlue 3Q was behind consensus with a better-than-expected 4Q revenue outlook. Greenbrier had a 4Q26 EPS miss, FY27 guide below consensus, and remains Sell. Hartford had an EPS beat from CATS, PYD and expense ratio.
Commodities: the Europe Winter Tracker says TTF pricing signals high winter tightness risk. A coffee note is titled 'The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly'.
The 4Q26 Treasury Refunding Preview and the US Midterm Preview were published. A GS webinar on midterm elections is scheduled for November 4.

JetBlue 3Q: behind consensus, with a 4Q revenue outlook better than expected.
Greenbrier 4Q26 (Aug): EPS miss, FY27 EPS guide below consensus, Sell-rated.
Hartford: EPS beat driven by CATS, PYD and expense ratio.
Kinder Morgan 3Q26 recap: solid quarter, with more than $5B in new projects anchoring the multi-year growth outlook. GS is watching the 2027 guide.
Graco 3Q26 EPS reported, with a weaker near-term growth outlook and estimates updated.

Previews: Dollar General 3Q26 (metrics strong but moderating from peak 2Q levels), BBWI 3Q, BJ's 3Q26 (mixed price and value trends), Apple F4Q26 (iPhone 18 family and Duo to drive F2027 growth), Kosmos 3Q26 (higher production estimates), Allianz, Hannover Re and M&G 3Q26.
Assa Abloy 3Q26 EBIT beat is likely, driving low-single-digit upgrades. Wartsila and Alfa Laval had 3Q26 order beats, with consensus upgrades likely.

China and Asia 3Q26: Richful missed. Milkyway beat on topline. OPT Machine Vision beat. Yiheda beat. Hangzhou First Applied Material missed and lowered FY26 guidance. Sinocera revenue beat was tempered by softer margins.
Amkor: weaker smartphone and consumer results offset strength in computing and advanced packaging.
